page_title: Photo Quality Enhancer: Fix Blurry Photos Online Free | Clarpex

sources.entry: Clarpex AI - Free online AI photo fixer to unblur, restore old photos, colorize black and white photos, remove glare and upscale to 4K or 8K, with daily free credits and no sign-up. #freemium #photo

summary.name: Clarpex
summary.one_liner: Clarpex is a browser-based AI photo quality enhancer that sharpens blurry, noisy, low-resolution, or faded photos, including old family photos.
use_cases: Sharpen a blurry portrait or product shot
Enlarge a small or low-resolution image
Clean up grainy or noisy photos
Restore faded or scratched old family photos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI tool that takes JPG, PNG or WebP uploads and rebuilds blur, noise, pixelation, and missing detail, while also upscaling the image. Users choose a Standard or Pro mode, with the credit cost shown before processing. A before/after slider lets users compare the result with the original before downloading. It runs in the browser with no software to install. The page contrasts it with sharpening filters and resampling in Photoshop or Lightroom, saying it generates new detail rather than only boosting edges. Limits on input are up to 20 MB and 40 megapixels, with larger images scaled down automatically.
notable: Before/after slider to compare results before download
Runs in the browser with no sign-up needed for basic use
Uploads are used only for the result, not for AI training, and deleted after 24 hours without an account
caveats: Heavy motion blur or subjects covering only a few pixels cannot be fully recovered
Very small faces can change slightly in results
Free tier gives 10 credits per day (Standard costs 2); Pro uses purchased credits and free credits do not carry over
